name: Freedom of inquiry
fuller_gloss: The right to ask, investigate, and publish without needing prior permission or fear of punishment.
tension_example: Can conflict with Loyalty when what the evidence shows is unwelcome to a group you belong to.

name: Equal standing
fuller_gloss: Treating people as equally entitled to be heard and taken seriously, regardless of status.
tension_example: Can conflict with Expertise when a well-informed voice and an inexperienced one disagree.
